---

### Installing

Copy the zip to the player, unpack it into a folder of its own and run `volumio plugin install` there; then switch the plugin on and restart the player once. If something is not as it should be: https://github.com/foonerd/unspike/issues

### Support Unspike

Unspike is free and open source, designed, built and maintained by one developer in his own time. If it has earned a place on your player, you can support its development:
